Oliver (AE): Passing PraxisOne to CS — deal signed today. 12-month, Dedicated 4xGPU with Hosted fallback. Customer priorities: Okta SCIM + extra SAML claims (team, cost_center), 2yr audit retention, optional VPC peering. Aim: PROD in ~6 weeks.
Tess (CSM): thanks Oliver. please drop contract link and any pilot playbook. I'll own kickoff + weekly cadence.
Oliver (AE): contract: https://redwood.example/contract/PRA-2026. Pilot notes: ~130 rps in small loadgen, p95 gen ~210ms, used streaming + rerank. Costs aligned with quote.
Oliver (AE): risks: 1) legal needs 2yr retention guarantee 2) custom claims mapping untested for their Okta instance 3) prod canary in week 4 if infra ok.
Tess (CSM): Nina — can you validate SAML claim mapping + SCIM provisioning viability in a Dedicated tenant? also confirm whether full audit logs can be exported to customer S3 with their KMS.
Nina (SRE): I can run a staging pass. Need either Okta metadata or a test org admin invite. Audit logs -> export to S3 is supported, but must validate encryption/KMS and retention lifecycle. ETA 72h.
Ravi (Support): I'll open support tickets for SSO/SCIM and for audit export. tagging eng-platform if infra touches required.
Tess (CSM): owners/action items:
- Tess: schedule kickoff, acceptance criteria doc, weekly updates
- Nina: SAML/SCIM test plan + audit export options (72h)
- Ravi: create and triage tickets by EOD
- Oliver: provide customer eng contacts + confirm canary window
Nina (SRE): testing plan (short):
1) request Okta metadata
2) validate SAML claims mapping in staging dedicated tenant
3) perform SCIM provisioning dry-run
4) attempt audit log export -> S3 bucket + KMS key handshake
If claim mapping needs non-standard claim transforms, that may be a small config change (~3 business days).
Ravi (Support): Tickets created: SUP-9810 "PraxisOne: SSO/SCIM validation" and SUP-9811 "PraxisOne: Audit export/retention". Added pilot logs and link to contract. Pinging eng-platform oncall.
Tess (CSM): acceptance criteria draft (initial): ingest 100k tokens/day, p95 gen <250ms, successful SSO login with mapped claims, SCIM provisioning working for group sync, logs exportable & accessible for 2yrs.
Oliver (AE): customer also requested clearer breakdown of per-routing policy cost. mark as product feedback; I can take point on communicating estimates pre-go-live.
Nina (SRE): heads-up: if we add claim transforms server-side, we need a small config rollout; may impact canary schedule by ~5 business days. Will advise.
Ravi (Support): @Nina include minimal repro and config diffs in SUP-9810 so eng-platform can triage quickly.
Tess (CSM): setting Renewal_Risk=medium due to legal retention ask until export/KMS confirmed. Also logging feedback item: cost transparency per routing policy -> will add to product board after kickoff.
calendar-bot: invite scheduled: "PraxisOne onboarding kickoff" Thu 09:00 PT (Tess, Nina, Ravi, Oliver) :bell:
Tess (CSM): next steps recap: Oliver to send eng contacts + confirm canary preference by EOD, Nina to post SAML/SCIM findings here by 1799995287, Ravi to update tickets with test results, Tess to publish acceptance criteria and run kickoff. We'll reconvene after Nina's report. 
Oliver (AE): on it — thanks everyone.
